label: Go performance budgets (go test -bench)
description: The Benchmark functions of a Go module, compared with the budgets (tools.<id>.budgets) and the baseline file (tools.<id>.baseline) of the instance. Comes in by evidence: a _test.go file at the module root with a Benchmark function; runs only where performance is switched on (the strict profile turns it on when available). Until budgets or a baseline are set the check is not applicable here, with the setting to configure.
